National Gunsmithing services are now available! If you like hunting, we’re here to get you all set up with everything you need. Popular pursuits include elk, mule deer, pronghorn antelope, California bighorn sheep, chukar, and quail. If fishing is more your speed, we have all of your tackle to catch the brown, rainbow, and Lahonton cutthroat trout that you’re after. We also carry plenty of supplies for hiking, kayaking, boating, camping, and backpacking. Simply tell us about your item(s) and where you’re located and we'll instantly return your item’s estimated worth in your local area. Try it today! Gold Buying There’s no better place to sell your gold and diamond jewelry than EZPAWN. Our expert gold buyers pay top dollar for gold and diamond jewelry or broken gold of any weight or karat. We test all precious metals to help ensure you get a fair and accurate price. Online Shop We make bargain hunting easy with our online shop. Check new arrivals daily, browse thousands of items, and discover great deals. Pawn Loans Bring us something in decent working condition and get cash in your pocket. It’s that easy. If you’ve never pawned anything before, don’t worry, we’ll show you how it all works. Come in and see what your items are worth. The more they’re worth, the more we can lend. Pawn transactions are a loan subject to terms and conditions, including fees. Please see a Team Member for additional information. Retail Merchandise Save 25% to 70% off new retail prices every day on quality approved pre-owned brand-name merchandise. Looking for a new Samsung HDTV or Apple smartphone? We carry thousands of brand-name items you know and love. Plus, we get new merchandise every day. Disclaimer: All items pre-owned. Trademarks owned by their respective brand owner. No brand owner endorses or is affiliated with EZPAWN family of stores. Firearms Firearms are valuable and their loan value is very good. At select stores, we loan on many different types, including rifles, shotguns, handguns and more. We’ll carefully evaluate your firearm, help you get the most money and store it on-site at our secure facility. We’ll also BUY your guns and collectible firearms. Appraisal and amount offered for your firearms are at the sole discretion of each location. Terms and conditions apply. Redemption of pawned firearms are subject to additional conditions, including a background check unless exempted by law. See Team Member for details. Layaway or Take Today Payment Options Layaway Take advantage of our convenient Layaway option. With only 10% down you’ll get easy-to-afford monthly payments. Typical uses are T-Ball, Little League. Bases set to 60 feet.  Permanent pitching mound set at 46 feet. Distances from home plate to outfield portable fence: Left Field — 148 feet Center Field — 161 feet Right Field — 145 feet Multi-Use:  RVSP has five multi-use fields designated Field 1, Field 2, Field 3a, Field 3b, and Joan Kelly. Joan Kelly’s dimensions are: 283’ x 187’ and typically has a youth soccer field pantied in white, and a youth lacrosse field painted in yellow. Field #1 and #2 dimensions are: 347’ x 225’ and typically have a soccer field pantied in white and a youth lacrosse field painted in yellow. In the fall there is a football field painted on Field #2 Field #3 dimensions are: 487’ x 300’ and typically has two adult soccer field that is slightly smaller due to the 300’ limit on the length. (Field #3 has a baseball field on the west side) Special Events at the Park Sagan Fondo Cycling Event and Festival came to Truckee as competitors and spectators watched and rode the exciting cycling race designed for all-levels of inspiring athletes. Riverview fields served as a spacious area for vendors and spectators to enjoy LIVE MUSIC, BEER, LOCAL FOOD, and VENDOR EXPO! Playground Bocce Ball Courts are open to the public.  Bring your own balls. Coed Bocce Ball League BBQ, enjoy a beverage, and play Bocce! Form a team of 4-8 players & register—an excellent location for summer fun. Our league is a fantastic way to get together with family, friends & co-workers. Whether you’re spending the day on the trails, teeing off at your favorite golf course, enjoying Truckee Thursdays, or hopping over to Tahoe, Cabona’s has the styles that fit your Truckee lifestyle. From breathable hiking shirts to cozy flannels, stylish lake-day dresses to performance pants, our clothing combines quality and comfort—at prices that make sense. Looking for the perfect finishing touch? We carry a curated collection of accessories including hats, bags, scarves, and Pendleton blankets, so you can head out ready for anything—from a mountaintop picnic to a sunset paddle. Locally Loved, Visitor Recommended Whether you’re a longtime local or just passing through, you’ll find a warm welcome at Cabona’s. Our knowledgeable staff is here to help you find the right fit, discover a new favorite brand, or pick up that must-have piece you didn’t know you needed. Rooted in Truckee, Built for Tahoe Cabona’s is more than a store—it’s a piece of Truckee history. We’re proud to be the town’s oldest retail business and part of what makes downtown special. Come in and see why generation after generation trusts Cabona’s for quality, style, and friendly service. Definitely check out their company The Water Traveler! So fun! Sarah · July 2024 Captain ALi and her team were absolutely amazing to work with during our wedding weekend. They went out of their way to make the event fun and personalized, from the activities available to the food and drinks to the decor, and to say they exceeded our expectations would be an understatement. They were by far the easiest and most fun vendor we worked with throughout our wedding weekend and the day-of execution was flawless. We could not be more thankful to Captain ALi and her entire team for going out of their way to make it so special for us. THANK YOU! Sudhish · 2022 Hugely fun day with the family on Lake Tahoe with every kind of water toy imaginable. Captain Ali and her crew made it all a blast and even got us beginners wake surfing. A huge bonus was not having to prepare for this at all. They gathered the toys, food, alcohol, towels, everything. We just showed up and had fun. Dee · 2022 I went out to Lake Tahoe for my bachelor party and we chartered two boats with Ali and her team. 18 of us, so we were a handful. They were unbelievable and amazing! Unforgettable experience. It was so much more than I could have hoped for. They not only took care of us as advertised but went way above and beyond. Captain Ali and her team were amazing and people would be crazy to not book with them. Seriously an amazing experience and I would recommend Tahoe Lake Love to everyone I know and everyone I don't. shaunsguideservice.net.text: Shaun's Guide Service | Donner Lake Fishing Guide Shaun's Guide Service Home About Gallery Book a Trip Shaun's Guide Service Over 40 years of fishing experience. Full-time since 2015. Licensed, bonded, and insured. Book Your Trip Call 530-802-4484 40+ Years Fishing 139+ Mackinaw Over 10 lbs 6 Guests Per Trip 365 Days a Year Donner Lake • Collins Lake • Sacramento River • Feather River • Stampede Reservoir • Boca Reservoir • Prosser Creek Reservoir Why Fish With Shaun Personal guided trips for up to six people, plus instruction on your own boat 🐟 Trophy Mackinaw Pro Big Mackinaw are Shaun's specialty. Since 2015, over 139 lake trout over 10 pounds have been caught and released. Spring is prime time for monster Mackinaw, plus a solid shot at big browns. 🛡️ Licensed & Insured US Coast Guard License #7611440. California Department of Fish and Wildlife guide license #1000439. Fully bonded and insured. 🗺️ Multiple Waterways Guided trips on Donner Lake, Stampede, Boca, and Prosser Creek reservoirs, plus spring Striped Bass and fall-run King Salmon on the Sacramento and Feather rivers. Year-round operation. Your Next Adventure Starts Here What You'll Catch Trophy Lake Trout (Mackinaw), eating-size Mackinaw, German Brown trout, Kokanee, King Salmon, Rainbow trout, and Striped Bass. Shaun will make sure your day is filled with catching experiences. Donner Lake — Lake Trout (Mackinaw) all year, Rainbows all year, and Kokanee June to November Sacramento & Feather Rivers — Chinook (King) Salmon August to December. Striped Bass (Stripers) March to mid-May Stampede & Boca Reservoirs — Kokanee (if they're not tiny), mid-May to September Prosser Creek Reservoir — Lahontan Cutthroat Trout and Rainbow Trout, June to August Collins Lake — Rainbow Trout November and April All fishing times change with weather. What Clients Say Real reviews from real trips ★★★★★ We fished with Shaun in early June on a Veteran's fishing day. We fished Stampede Reservoir. We were all back at the dock by 11:00 with limits for each of us. Shaun is a knowledgeable and hard working guide. Thank you Shaun for a fun and productive morning on the water. — Artie M. ★★★★★ I'd give Shaun 10 stars if they let me, what a great experience. He put us on the monsters all day and we had such an awesome time relaxing with him and his adorable pooch. Pulling in 2 lakers over 10 lbs and then fish after fish after fish didn't hurt either. I will be going with Shaun's guide service for many years to come. — Morgan P. ★★★★★ Awesome day on the water with Shaun's guide service. He knows the Donner Lake fishery very well and will put you on fish all day. We caught limits of fish early and had a great time. I recommend Shaun and would love to go out with him again! — Pear ★★★★★ Wanted to take my 5 year old son on our first fishing experience and Shaun was great. Son had a blast and Shaun was a great guide. — Arian C. ★★★★★ Shaun recently took our family (3 younger kids) on a fishing trip in the Tahoe area. He delivered on his promise of getting us 25 fish (our limit), and we then ate fish for days! Shaun was a great fishing educator for the kids. — Matt K. From Google Reviews On the Water A look at what's waiting for you View Full Gallery Pro-Staff & Equipment Shaun is pro-staff for Paulina Peak Tackle Company, Yakima Bait, Daiwa, and Scotty Fishing Products. Top-tier gear on every trip. The main vessel is a 22-foot Boulton Sea Skiff with a full top, side curtains, back drop curtain, and a heater for those cold Donner mornings. It's so warm buttoned up, you'll be comfortable even in winter. For Feather River King Salmon, trips run out of a Design Concepts jet boat that seats four comfortably. Shaun also offers guide instruction on your boat to help you dial in your catch rate. Call for pricing. Ready to Land the Big One? Shaun's Guide Service operates all year round. Book your trip today. chaosreno.com.text: CHAOS Estate Boutique | Place to Shop in Reno, NV - Chaos Reno: Expert Estate Sales & Organizing Services STORE ESTATE SALES CONTACT Shop our Store Wednesday - Sunday 11 am - 5 pm CHAOS Estate Boutique 1311 So. Virginia Street, Suite 105 Reno, NV 89502 Reno's Favorite Place to Shop. See the Hottest Estate Sale Finds! Meet Debbie Owner of CHAOS Estate Boutique Out of life’s chaos come the stories, memories, and treasures that make a house feel like home. For more than thirteen years, I’ve had the privilege of helping families throughout Reno and Northern Nevada navigate life’s transitions. Through my estate sale and organizing work, I’ve met incredible people and discovered thousands of fascinating items—each with its own history and story. ​ Along the way, I kept thinking about how wonderful it would be to create a space where those treasures could live on and be appreciated by someone new. That idea eventually became CHAOS Estate Boutique. Today, our store offers nearly 5,000 square feet of carefully selected items—a blend of vintage pieces, antiques, home décor, collectibles, artwork, furniture, jewelry, books, rugs, and so much more. You’ll also find hobby items, trains, sporting goods, electronics, kitchen pieces, costumes, and everyday items that still have plenty of life left in them. Some pieces arrive through estate sales we manage across Reno and Northern Nevada, while others come from trusted consignors who want their special items to find the right home. We also occasionally bring in new items and unique overstock finds to keep the store fresh and exciting. What makes CHAOS special is that nothing stays the same for long. Every week, new treasures arrive, displays change, and customers discover something unexpected. It’s the kind of place where you can wander through the store and suddenly find the perfect gift, a beautiful piece of vintage décor, or something you didn’t even know you were looking for. My hope is that CHAOS Estate Boutique becomes a place people love to visit—whether they’re hunting for antiques, searching for collectibles, decorating their home, or simply enjoying the thrill of discovering something unique. If you enjoy the charm of vintage finds, estate treasures, and one-of-a-kind pieces, I invite you to come explore with us. You never know what treasure might be waiting for you. ​ Debbie "The store is set-up so nice, easy to shop, lots of great stuff!" Thanks for the Reviews! CHAOS Estate Boutique 1311 So. Virginia Street Suite 105 Reno, NV 89502 OPEN Wednesday - Sunday 11 am - 5 pm Debbie Cox, Owner  ​775-560-1656 [email protected] Estate Liquidation Services for Reno, Sparks, Carson City, and Tahoe Chaos Estate Boutique in Reno |  ADA Compliance STORE ESTATE SALES CONTACT var _gaq = _ga

Fly Rods Each cane we have chosen for our rods has been seasoned for forty years. This select stock is hand split, carefully sectioning out each strip in preparation for hand planing the delicate tapers. The traditional and accurate art of hand planing assures the strongest rod possible. Read More Fly Rod Restoration / Repair When contemplating a bamboo fly rod restoration of a family antique, we would like to assure you of our experience with carefully handling and successfully restoring these relics. Kane Klassics would love to bring back your rods functionality and protect its future. Read More Bamboo Putters Our putters are extensively customizable with choice of steel, graphite or bamboo shafts, mallet, blade, or chipper putter heads and fitted standard, waist, or chest length clubs. Under every putter’s unique bamboo grip;length, date of construction and your name are inscribed. Read More Thank you all again, and as always keep in touch... Our custom-built aircraft hangar and workshop area has allowed for a large workspace and office. We are located in Reno, Nevada, at the center of the Reno-Stead Airport, home of the Reno Air Races. Kane Klassics has been crafting bamboo and graphite rods since 1988. Our 25 year existence has been made possible by our enthusiastic supporters who continuously chose the durability and elegance of Kane Klassics rods. These supporters know the secret to getting the most from their fly-fishing endeavors. Hunting is an earned privilege and success is never guaranteed. However, we do guarantee the most memorable hunt you will experience in the field.  Whether you choose a short two-day hunt or a long, big game hunt adventure, we are dedicated to your opportunity.  Ground Zero has been established by blue-collar people who help fulfill the dreams of others. We are unique. The Ground Zero name came from our many years hunting in the field after working all week and taking off at five on Friday afternoons. We will make your choice, a memory of a lifetime.
